title: TAGR: Temporally Adaptive Generative Recommendation for Industrial Live-Streaming Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2608.24034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Live-streaming advertising is an important monetization channel on short-video and e-commerce platforms, where rapidly changing live content, promoted products, and user feedback impose strong freshness requirements on recommendation models. Existing generative recommenders designed for static domains fail at three levels: static semantic IDs (SID) cannot track evolving live ads; single-scale behavior modeling misses shifting intent; preference optimization conflicts between fresh on-policy feedback and training stability. We propose TAGR, a generative recommendation framework with temporal adaptation at three levels: live-ad tokenization, user intent modeling, and preference alignment. At the token level, Live Semantic-Collaborative ID (LSID) periodically refreshes each active ad's SID based on its current live scene and promoted products, while retaining a stable hierarchical token vocabulary for autoregressive generation. translated_title: TAGR：面向工业直播广告的时间自适应生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 直播广告是短视频和电商平台重要的变现渠道，其中快速变化的直播内容、推广产品和用户反馈对推荐模型提出了很强的时效性要求。现有为静态领域设计的生成式推荐器在三个层面存在不足：静态语义ID（SID）无法跟踪不断演变的直播广告；单尺度行为建模忽略了意图转移；偏好优化在新鲜的在策略反馈与训练稳定性之间冲突。我们提出TAGR，一种在三个层面具有时间自适应性的生成式推荐框架：直播广告令牌化、用户意图建模和偏好对齐。在令牌层面，直播语义协作ID（LSID）基于当前直播场景和推广产品定期刷新每个活跃广告的SID，同时保留稳定的分层令牌词汇表用于自回归生成。在意图层面...
tldr: TAGR通过三层时间自适应机制（令牌级动态ID刷新、意图级多尺度建模、偏好级在线稳定对齐）解决了直播广告推荐中内容快速变化导致的时效性问题。
en_tdlr: TAGR addresses the freshness challenges in live-streaming advertising recommendation through three-level temporal adaptation—dynamic token ID refreshment, multi-scale intent modeling, and stable preference alignment.
